jobs.title: Executive Director, Strategic Sourcing (Protein)
jobs.description:
Summary Of Job Description

The Executive Director, Strategic Sourcing (Protein) is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the development of strategies and the strategic optimal arrangements related to the sourcing of various product/service categories for the company through collaboration with the other departments. This position’s portfolio of products is high in dollars expenditure (approximately $900 million+ in sourcing span management) and in its level of impact on the company’s financial performance and reputation. The Executive Director executes and oversees the selection, evaluation, and negotiation for PRG purchases in various categories, ensuring that the suppliers selected fit Panda’s culture and philosophy, have the necessary capacity, provide the items at the best price and highest quality.

Job Responsibilities

Oversees and optimizes the development and execution of sourcing strategy using the 10-step strategic sourcing process for assigned products and categories in support of its business strategy and plan. Identifies suppliers and arranges optimal contracts in terms of pricing, quality, timing, and supply availability over the term of the contract. Interacts with the highest level of executives at supplier companies. Advises senior leadership on the availability of specific products and pricing, pre-qualifying new suppliers and facilities in terms of price, capacity, safety and quality. Ensures costs are within budget.
Oversees and provides coaching and leadership in commodities markets on prices and supply and oversees the strategy and direction for optimal procurement and logistics program.
Responsible for achieving strategic optimal arrangements related to sourcing various product/service categories for the company through collaboration with the related departments. Executes the company’s sourcing arrangements in support of its business strategy and plan. Identifies suppliers and arranges optimal contracts in terms of pricing, quality, timing, and supply availability over the term of the contract. Interacts with the highest level of executives at supplier companies. Advises senior leadership on the availability of specific products and pricing, pre-qualifying new suppliers and facilities in terms of price, capacity, and quality. Ensures costs are within budget.
Supports SVP and VP of Supply Chain to develop and execute the three- to five-year sourcing strategic plans and strategic supplier partnerships, anticipating business requirements. The plan includes identifying supplier sources, their purchasing capacity, and any legal/tariff issues. Informs the VP and senior leadership on industry insights, such as tariffs, import/export limitations, government regulations, Act of God situations, mergers, acquisitions, personnel changes, new item introduction, etc.
Recruits, selects, and develops an effective team of purchasing management, professional, and support staff. Provides leadership, coaching and development to the team to meet the department’s people planning and development goals.
Identifies new suppliers to support future growth. Attends supplier and industry shows to identify potential suppliers, domestic and international. Evaluates potential suppliers in collaboration with other PRG departments concerning the viability of their product and acceptability of their manufacturing facility. Negotiates optimal pricing with new suppliers.
Maintains a strong relationship between suppliers and the company. Communicates with suppliers concerning PRG philosophy and growth plans and aligns suppliers with Panda to support growth. Evaluates the effectiveness of suppliers to identify which ones to expand the relationship.
Ensures sourcing alignment with cross-functional business objectives. Leads or supports cross-functional projects with departments such as FSQA, Product Development, Marketing, Legal, Finance, RD, and Operations related to product specifications, quality inquiries, product recall, sourcing new ingredients, testing new products, and phasing in products within distribution.

How We Reward You

Hybrid Work schedule
401K with company match
Yearly bonus opportunity*
Full medical, dental, and vision insurance *
On-site fitness center, biometric screen, and flu shot clinic
Discounts at Panda restaurants, theme parks, and gym memberships
Paid time off starting at 15 days with 7 federal holidays*
Continuous education assistance and scholarships*
Income protection including Disability, Life and AD&D insurance*
Bereavement leave*
Benefits available for eligible permanent full time associates

Your Background And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business or equivalent field required; MBA preferred
12+ years of experience in Supply Chain Management, preferably in a nationally branded retail/hospitality organization
Successful completion of initial and periodically required trainings.
Obtaining a valid Food Handler's Card within 30 days of employment is a requirement of this position.

Pay Range:
M5: $205,000 - $288,000 / Annual

Within the range, individual pay is determined using various factors, including work location and experience.

Panda Strong Since 1983

Founded in Glendale, California, we are now the largest family-owned American Chinese Restaurant concept in America. With close to 2,800 locations globally, we continue our mission of delivering exceptional Asian dining experiences by building an organization where people are inspired to better their lives. Whether it’s impacting our team or the communities we work in, we’re proud to be an organization that embraces family values.

jobs.description:
Director of Client Operations

EQ Private Wealth Advisors — Palos Verdes, CA

Who We Are

At EQ Private Wealth Advisors, we don’t just manage portfolios. We serve as the Financial Directors
of our clients' lives—helping them navigate their futures through sophisticated financial planning strategies and comprehensive wealth management. We are a high-touch, boutique firm where our clients are treated as family and friends, not account numbers. We’ve stepped away from the "corporate chain" model to build a practice rooted in deep relationships, trust, and a commitment to "Unreasonable Hospitality."

The Role

We are seeking a Director of Client Operations
to be the "Anchor" of our firm. This is a role for a highly organized, detailed oriented, and licensed professional who takes pride in "owning the ecosystem." You are the "Safe Pair of Hands" that ensures nothing falls through the cracks, allowing our advisors to focus entirely on strategy while you ensure the office and our clients are meticulously cared for.
This is a full-time, in-office position
based in our Palos Verdes office. We believe the best collaboration and the highest level of service happen when we are working side-by-side.
Who You Are

The Practice Custodian:
You have a naturally protective nature over the office, the advisors, and the families we serve. You have an authoritative yet warm presence, ensuring the "house" is always in order.
Proactive & Autonomous:
You don’t want or need to be micromanaged. You anticipate needs before they are voiced and take full ownership of your domain.
High Emotional Intelligence:
You can navigate complex family dynamics and high-net-worth relationships with grace, professional "straight talk," and genuine empathy.
Chief of Staff Mindset:
You take pride in being the engine that keeps the firm running, ensuring the advisors are supported and the client experience is flawless.

Core Responsibilities

Unreasonable Hospitality:
You believe that "good service" is the floor and "wowing" the client is the ceiling. You’ll ensure every client interaction feels personal, premium, and thoughtful.
Operations & Workflow Mastery:
You will execute money movement, trades, and account maintenance with 100% accuracy using Wealthbox CRM
and our custodial platforms, LPL Financial
and Schwab
.
Advisor Support & Meeting Readiness:
You ensure advisors are perfectly prepared for every meeting—files are ready, tech is tested, and the follow-up process is already in motion.
Event Architect:
You will take the lead on organizing 3–4 intimate, high-quality client events per year
, managing everything from the guest list to the final "wow" detail.

Qualifications

The Essentials:
Active Series 7 and Series 66
(or 63 and 65) licenses are required
.
Experience:
5+ years in wealth management. We are looking for someone with the industry "mileage" to handle ACATS, RMDs, and Trust documentation without a learning curve.
Technical Savvy:
Proficiency with Wealthbox
, LPL ClientWorks
, or Schwab Advisor Center
is a significant plus.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary:
$85,000 – $120,000 (based on experience, professional designation, and licensing).
Retirement:
401(k) plan with a Safe Harbor match
.
Health Benefits Available

Work Culture:
A collaborative, boutique environment in the South Bay—skip the DTLA/Century City commute and work in the community where you live.
Growth:
We are committed to your professional development and long-term career path as a leader within the firm.

Job Description

We're seeking a future team member for the role of Managing Director, Head of North American Distribution.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways:

Lead the North America distribution business for BNY Investments, setting and executing the regional commercial strategy across institutional and intermediary channels.
Drive revenue growth, net new asset flows, and client retention across North America in alignment with enterprise and platform objectives.
Oversee client coverage and distribution efforts across Wealth, Retirement, and Institutional segments.
Serve as the senior executive sponsor for key client relationships and strategic opportunities across the region.
Lead and support complex mandate pursuits, including origination, negotiation, pricing, and deal structure decisions.
Deliver against annual sales, revenue, and net flow targets for North America.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, consultants, intermediaries, and internal stakeholders.
Provide strategic market insight on client needs, competitive dynamics, and regional growth opportunities to the Global Head of Distribution and platform leadership.
Partner closely with investment, product, marketing, operations, legal, compliance, and risk teams to ensure coordinated execution and strong client outcomes.
Ensure adherence to all regulatory, compliance, and conduct standards applicable to North America distribution activity.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing regional distribution organization, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and client focus.
Act as a visible senior leader for BNY Investments internally and externally in the North America market.

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following:

Bachelor's degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Advanced/graduate degree preferred
12+ years of total work experience preferred.
Significant senior leadership experience in asset management, investments distribution, institutional sales, or client coverage.
Deep knowledge of North America distribution models and the institutional and intermediary marketplace.
Proven track record of delivering revenue growth, asset raising results, and client retention outcomes at scale.
Familiarity with regulatory, compliance, and conduct requirements relevant to North America distribution businesses.
Exceptional executive presence, leadership capability, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a global matrixed organization and influence at the most senior levels.

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

Who We Are

Horizon Next
is one of the industry's most innovative and data-driven marketing organizations and sits at the intersection of three constantly changing landscapes: people, data, and media. Our business provides strategic leadership to accelerate growth for our clients through brand strategy, media planning and investment, and best in class analytics across all channels. As the leader in innovative business solutions, we are always pushing ourselves to understand what’s next: our next innovation, our next advancement in analytics, the market’s next media evolution, and your next breakthrough idea. Horizon Next operates with the single goal that tomorrow must outperform today.

At Horizon, we understand the value that different perspectives can bring to our clients and culture, so we strive for an environment where our employees feel welcomed, safe and empowered. We value YOU and believe that your authentic voice and unique perspective allows us to create a more rewarding culture, and experience, together.

Our simple recipe for success? We hire talented people (thinkers, doers, dreamers, makers), challenge them and give them every opportunity to grow.

Lead the team in translating client goals into strategic media solutions that grow our client’s brands and ensure strategic consistency across all elements of plan development and implementation, heavily focusing on performance-based media & analytics driven approach to client success

Guide team in setting goals and professional development timelines, ensure team members have challenging, level-appropriate projects and opportunities to learn new skills
Ensure team members have support needed to achieve development goals
Active role in conversations around staffing needs
Promote the work of both junior and senior team members, set a positive team environment

Proactively take part in continued learning opportunities internally and externally
Maintain active knowledge of industry trends, attending relevant industry conferences and events
Uses this knowledge to influence and innovate for clients & internal teams

A strong writer, presenter and communicator; who can communicate complex ideas with ease
A strong team leader with people management skills
A self-starter who can work both independently and collaboratively to bring ideas to completion
A calculated risk taker with the foresight to understand implications
Innately curious, with a hunger for proactive and creative problem solving

The Arc of Union County Inc. is a leading provider of person-centered services for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, offering a variety of programs and services. jobs.title: Contract and Compliance Board Executive Director - Construction (Gen Srvc Div Mgr)
jobs.description:
Position Description

The Contract and Compliance Board Executive Director
(General Services Division Manager) serves as the principal administrative advisor to the Contract and Compliance Board, providing executive leadership and operational support to the Board by coordinating its activities, facilitating effective governance, and ensuring the Board carries out its responsibilities in accordance with its establishing ordinance, applicable laws, and accepted parliamentary procedures. The Executive Director also serves as the primary liaison between the Board, Metro departments, Metro Legal, contractors, consultants, and the public to support informed decision-making and the implementation of Board actions.

This position is responsible for meeting, evaluating, and monitoring compliance with construction contracts related to construction activities on projects by the Metropolitan Government and performing related duties as required. The Executive Director is responsible for supporting the Board's oversight of contract compliance by monitoring contractual duties and obligations, administering the complaint process, and ensuring that complaints are appropriately evaluated, investigated, and reported to the Board and other appropriate entities.

Typical Duties

Reviews, evaluates, and monitors compliance with construction contracts related to construction activities on projects by the Metropolitan Government.
Reviews construction sites, if such review is in connection with the evaluation of existing construction contracts.
Oversees the investigations of complaints related toconstruction contracts wherein the metropolitan government is a party and related to the relevant construction sites.
Studies best practices on public construction worksites and provide recommendations concerning improvements in worksite safety on Metropolitan Government construction worksites.
Conducts market analyses of projects, contractors, contracts, and workers operating on Metro projects routinely to help measure, track, and improve Metro projects.
Writes data-driven reports and recommendations on the construction landscape, with detailed explanation of the state of the industry on Metro projects along with corrective processes, as warranted.
Collaborates with the Metro Law Department to develop recommendations for enhancing worksite safety and compliance measures in construction contracts.
Conducts qualitative and quantitative research and analysis to identify opportunities and obstacles regarding the construction landscape on Metro projects.
Oversees and prepares presentations.
Attends meetings and workshops, as needed.
Performs various supervisory duties including assigning and monitoring work, approves leave requests, evaluates and reviews employee performance, counsel and correct employees, as needed.
Interprets rules and policies, as needed.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Develops strong and abundant relationships in the industry with workers, foremen, project managers, and subject matter experts of the industry.

Board Governance and Leadership

Serves as the principal administrative advisor to the Contract and Compliance Board, supporting the Board in carrying out its responsibilities under the establishing ordinance.
Provides leadership and strategic support to the Board Chair and Board members by coordinating annual work plans, meeting priorities, and implementation of Board initiatives.
Advises the Board on governance best practices, procedural requirements, and the appropriate exercise of its authority consistent with applicable laws and the Board's enabling ordinance.
Serves as the primary liaison between the Board, Metro departments, Metro Law, contractors, consultants, elected officials, and members of the public.
Fosters productive working relationships among Board members, Metro departments, contractors, consultants, and community stakeholders while maintaining impartiality and professionalism.

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university and five (5) years of managerial, financial, or administrative experience in a construction, trades, or related field or contract and/or construction inspection compliance.

**Additional years of experience identified in the list above may be considered in lieu of education (1 year for 1 year ratio)**

Candidates with accreditations earned in a foreign institute are encouraged to apply.

Note: Per Metro Ordinance No. SO94-1078. All employees of the Metropolitan Government shall be residents of the State of Tennessee or become residents of the state within six (6) months of employment as a prerequisite to employment with the Metropolitan Government.

Preferred Experience, Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Experience working with governing boards, boards and commissions, or executive leadership in a public-sector environment.
Familiarity with Robert's Rules of Order and the Tennessee Open Meetings Act, to facilitate orderly, fair, and effective meetings.
Experience navigating construction sites including knowledge of the trades on sites and related reporting structures, as well as any applicable safety or site requirements.
Experience with DOL, NLRB, OSHA, and TOSHA regulations.
Experience reviewing Metro or construction contracts and relevant State and Federal laws. Familiarity with labor violations and Unfair Labor Practices (ULPs) related to the NLRB, as well as contractual obligations with Metro and applicable State and Federal legislation.
Spanish proficiency.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. Metro Nashville is committed to selecting the most qualified candidate for each of our roles.

Metro Nashville Government respects the religious beliefs and practices of all employees and will make, on request, an accommodation for such observances when a reasonable accommodation is available that does not create an undue hardship on business operations.

Requests for ADA or other protected accommodations for the recruitment process should be directed to Human Resources at 615-862-6640.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Factory Advisors, we partner with industrial and manufacturing organizations to transform operations, unlock sustainable growth, and achieve measurable business outcomes. We don't just consult—we embed with our clients, lead change, and deliver lasting results.
As part of the integrated Factory Transformation
organization, combining Factory Advisors and GrayMatter, we help manufacturers connect operational excellence, digital technologies, and workforce enablement into one transformation strategy.
Our differentiated approach combines:
Operational Transformation
to optimize people, processes, and performance
Digital Transformation
to create visibility through systems, data, automation, and analytics
Approachable AI
to deliver actionable intelligence directly to frontline teams

Together, these capabilities help manufacturers close the gap between strategy and execution.
The Opportunity

We are seeking a seasoned Managing Director
to lead strategic manufacturing transformation initiatives at the intersection of operational excellence, business strategy, and execution.
This role is ideal for a consulting leader with deep manufacturing expertise who can serve as both trusted advisor and business builder. You will help clients solve complex operational challenges while partnering across the broader Factory Transformation organization to integrate Digital Transformation and Approachable AI solutions where they create additional value.
From business development and executive engagement through delivery leadership and firm building, you will own the full client lifecycle while helping shape the future of our Operational Transformation practice.
This role requires up to 75% travel.
What You'll Do

Business Development

Serve as both strategist and operator—originating and closing Operational Transformation opportunities while guiding the full lifecycle of client relationships
Develop trusted advisor relationships with executive leadership across manufacturing organizations
Generate and qualify leads, develop proposals, craft Statements of Work, and negotiate contracts with senior decision-makers
Design and execute go-to-market strategies focused on operational excellence, manufacturing transformation, supply chain performance, leadership development, and business performance
Expand existing accounts by identifying opportunities to integrate Operational Transformation, Digital Transformation, and Approachable AI capabilities
Collaborate across Factory Transformation to bring the full complement of services to address client needs
Own and manage sales and opportunity pipeline while meeting revenue and margin objectives
Build market credibility through thought leadership in manufacturing strategy, Lean, operational excellence, leadership systems, and business transformation
Stay ahead of emerging manufacturing technologies and operational trends, translating them into actionable client strategies

Own revenue targets and manage profitability across an Operational Transformation portfolio
Lead multidisciplinary consulting teams delivering complex transformation engagements
Serve as executive sponsor and engagement leader—scoping, staffing, and ensuring high-quality delivery
Facilitate executive strategy sessions with C-suite and operational leaders to define transformation roadmaps and business priorities
Translate complex operational challenges into scalable improvement strategies and measurable business results
Lead initiatives across manufacturing operations, Lean transformation, quality, supply chain, maintenance, leadership systems, and organizational effectiveness
Partner with Digital Transformation leaders to integrate technology-enabled solutions where appropriate
Leverage Approachable AI solutions to ensure operational knowledge and performance improvements are sustained at the point of work
Build long-term client partnerships by consistently delivering measurable value and trusted advisory services

Firm Building

Help define and scale the Operational Transformation practice within Factory Transformation
Reinforce and champion the firm's integrated approach of combining operational excellence, digital enablement, and workforce capability
Build and mentor a high-performing consulting team
Develop reusable methodologies, tools, playbooks, and intellectual property that integrate:

Operational Excellence
Lean Transformation
Leadership Systems
Digital Enablement
Approachable AI

Partner with GrayMatter and Factory Advisors leadership to align offerings, delivery models, and innovation initiatives
Lead firm initiatives including recruiting, capability development, strategic planning, and internal mentoring
Support internal training to ensure consulting teams understand and can effectively position Operational Transformation, Digital Transformation, and Approachable AI as complementary capabilities
Help shape the future growth, culture, and strategy of Factory Transformation

Requirements

What You'll Bring

Executive-level manufacturing leadership experience with a demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-site operations, large-scale business transformation, and enterprise performance improvement
15+ years in Director-level leadership roles with multi-site accountability, or 5+ years in a Vice President (or equivalent) role with enterprise-wide operational responsibility
Deep expertise in one or more of the following disciplines: Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Factory Operations, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, or Quality Engineering
Proven success building, developing, and leading high-performing teams while coaching senior leaders and creating a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence
Demonstrated experience in management consulting, operational transformation, or professional services, serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams
A successful track record of generating and growing business through net-new client acquisition, strategic account expansion, and executive relationship management
Recognized expertise in Lean Manufacturing, the Toyota Production System, Continuous Improvement, and manufacturing performance transformation
Strong understanding of Digital Transformation technologies and their role in enabling operational excellence, including connected worker solutions, manufacturing systems, AI-enabled tools, analytics, and smart factory initiatives
Proven ability to translate operational strategy into executable roadmaps that deliver measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee engagement
Experience leading complex, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives—from strategy development and executive alignment through implementation, sustainment, and change adoption
Executive presence with the ability to influence and build credibility at every level of an organization—from frontline operators to C-suite executives and private equity stakeholders
Exceptional leadership in project execution, facilitation, organizational change management, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment within complex manufacturing environments
Outstanding communication, executive presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex operational challenges into actionable business strategies
Bachelor's degree required
Eligible to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or other advanced business or engineering degree
Experience in Aerospace & Defense or other regulated manufacturing industries
Experience integrating digital manufacturing technologies into operational improvement initiatives, including familiarity with Industry 4.0 concepts and Connected Worker strategies

jobs.title: Sr. Business Development Director, Media Business
jobs.description:
Job Description

POLITICO seeks an experienced Sr. Business Development Director with a passion for storytelling to join our dynamic and growing Media Solutions team. The Director will leverage a deep understanding of POLITICO’s audience to provide thoughtful, creative and consequential opportunities for brands to engage with our audience. The Director must be entrepreneurial in spirit with the ability to craft insightful solutions as we problem solve for our clients. Ideal candidate will have a firm understanding of the public affairs ecosystem and advertising market trends.

As POLITICO’s Business Development team grows, we have re-envisioned the way a business development team engages with clients and agencies. We embrace individuals from immensely diverse professional and personal backgrounds in an ongoing effort to create a comprehensive and collaborative team that is driven to support not only our clients but one another.

What You’ll Do

Maintain and grow existing client and agency relationships
Respond to RFPs with creative solutions
Execute campaigns and analyze performance with the assistance of your dedicated Account Manager
Continue to embody the successful brand presence of POLITICO in the market

What You'll Need

Min of 5 years of experience in sales, digital advertising or marketing
Passion for journalism: individual who reveres and respects the art, science and creativity involved in journalism and its impact on our democracy
Knowledge of political influencer market: individual who understands the dynamic and complex ecosystem that drive public affairs decisions
Creativity: individual who wants to think outside of turnkey solutions for clients and is willing to dig deep into their initiatives and KPIs to create campaigns that will move the needle
Initiative: individual who has a desire to grow within their role and not only take on but create new opportunities
Collaboration: individual with the ability to collaborate across departments and work closely with POLITICO’s marketing and product development team to balance the company’s editorial integrity with client goals
Communication Skills: excellent oral and written communication skills to be used in presentations and written memos
BA/BS degree required
Experience with Keynote, Microsoft Suite, especially PowerPoint to be used in presentations and written memo

We value our people.
Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO.

Let’s keep in touch.
You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon!

About Us.

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital.

Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes.

Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist.

Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself.

These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization.

POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer .
